model.name: ASICS® GEL-1130 - Women's
model.description:
'

Why change something that‚Äôs perfect? Bringing you the late 2000s unmatchable runner aesthetic, the ASICS GEL-1130 is here to help you cover the miles in style. Decked up with striking details influenced by the GEL-KAYANO 14, the upper of these sneakers boast synthetic leather overlays and mesh underlays that rep the shoes‚Äô heritage upper design from 2008. The GEL technology cushioning absorbs shock as you run and feels delightfully soft underfoot. Featuring the TRUSSTIC support system of the late 2000s, these runners prevent excessive twisting and keep your feet stable even on tricky terrain. Run faster, harder, and longer with the ASICS GEL-1130.

ASICS GEL-1130 features:

  • Upper‚Äôs main material made with more than 20% recycled materials brings a sustainable edge to the overall design.
  • Dope-dyed sockliner helps reduce overall water usage by approximately 33% and carbon emissions by approximately 45%.
  • EVA midsole offers a lightweight, comfortable feel with every step.
  • Rubber outsole delivers superior traction and durability.

Long days on your feet feel easier in a pair that blends retro running style with everyday comfort. Inspired by late-2000s performance design, the ASICS GEL-1130 delivers breathable mesh, supportive synthetic leather overlays, and soft cushioning that transitions easily from walks and workouts to daily wear. Heritage running details influenced by the GEL-KAYANO 14 give this pair its distinctive look, while GEL technology and a TRUSSTIC support system help keep every step smooth and stable.

  • Mesh upper with synthetic leather overlays for breathable, structured support
  • GEL technology cushioning helps absorb impact for a softer underfoot feel
  • TRUSSTIC support system adds stability through your stride
  • EVA midsole offers lightweight comfort, while the rubber outsole provides durable traction
  • Upper uses more than 20% recycled materials, and the dope-dyed sockliner helps reduce water use and carbon emissions

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers find the fit comfortable and secure. For the best fit, we recommend starting with your regular size; if you are between sizes, prefer a little extra room, or plan to wear thicker socks, a half size up may feel best.

Best For

Best for everyday wear, long walks, commuting, gym sessions, and casual outfits that call for lightweight comfort and retro running style.

Styling & Versatility

The layered mesh-and-overlay design gives the GEL-1130 a clean throwback runner look that pairs easily with everything from athleisure to everyday outfits. Reviewers especially love how polished and wearable it feels for all-day plans, whether you're headed to work, the gym, or out for the weekend.

Break-In & Durability

Comfort is a standout from the start, with many reviewers saying this pair feels ready to wear right out of the box. Its lightweight build and supportive platform make it a reliable option for frequent wear and extended time on your feet.

"

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
